snippet.title: FREE TO PLAY -  Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush Official Game Release!
snippet.description:
G123's newest game "Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush" is finally here! Dive into this exciting roguelike RPG where simple controls let you mow down your enemies! Join the fluffy-eared girl Fran and the legendary "Teacher" and begin your adventure now!

Play Now: https://s.g123.jp/cog7xtt1

This is a full HTML5 game you can jump into instantly from any web browser on smartphone, tablet, or PC! Rich idle features make it perfect for quick plays, or blazing through battles on your phone while out and about, or for a deep session on PC at home. Play your way anytime, anywhere!

■Basic Game Info
Game Title: Reincarnated as a Sword Brave Rush
Genre: Roguelike RPG
Price: Free-to-play (in-game purchases available)
Languages (planned): Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, Korean

#ReincarnatedAsASword #Tenken #TenkenBR #RoguelikeRPG #G123 #FreeGame #F2P
